body:
OUTPUT BUNDLE RECUT RULING — exact e50c704 stays withdrawn; one successor is authorized inside the same 11 paths and raised to P0.

ExtendedBuildReceipt must become checked non-product data with exact BuildReceipt/stage coherence, but decoded receipt-shaped data does not prove that a build ran. It may not mint ValidatedBuild authority. Unless an actual resolver/orchestrator-issued unforgeable capability exists in this slice, downgrade the basis explicitly to receipt-matched/unverified or refuse it; remove public authority-bearing reconstruction from arbitrary checksums and IDs.

All successful-decode/admission and specialized-failure issuers move behind bare object-private checked paths; qualified package privacy is insufficient. A lawful Refused(BeforeIntake, failure) gets an exact metadata-only decode path and round-trips without bytes, while admitted/decoded/constructed states continue to require exact byte context.

Preserve the earlier source, payload, NotRequested, schema-v2, and KnownPayload scope. Exact attacks, controls, mutations, and gates are recorded in the bead decision. Required reviewers must replay the original caller-minted-build and BeforeIntake attacks before proposal. No path expansion, proposal, landing, close, release, or P1R authority.
